name: Design of Multicomponent Separation Processes
description: Overview of multi-component separation. Non-ideal solution and properties, equation of state, vapour-liquid equilibrium. Multi-component separation: short cut method, rigorous calculations - sum rate, boiling point, Newton's methods, inside-out method for designing multi-component distillation, absorption, and extraction column/contacting devices. Choice of the column: tray, random packing, and structured packing. Design of adsorption and ion exchange column. Crystallization. Membrane, affinity, and chromatographic separation and their equipment design. Optimal reflux ratio (recycle stream) – operating expenditure versus capital expenditure for all types of columns and contacting devices of a multi-component system. Implementation of computational methods for design of multi-component separation processes. Case studies and trouble-shooting related distillation and extraction and adsorption processes.
